## Completion summary

**Deliverable:** `packages/cli/__tests__/verify-13.test.js` (124 lines, written and persisted with all 3 relative imports resolving, no diagnostics).

**Coverage mapped to acceptance requirements** (6 cases, at the cap):

| Requirement | Case | Control |
|---|---|---|
| 正常小图可读且资源关闭 | 1 | Positive: real PNG → exact base64 data, `closeSync` called once |
| 超限输入被拒绝 (upper) | 2 | Negative of case 1: file truncated to `MAX_INPUT_IMAGE_BYTES+1` → `/20 MiB/`, `readSync` never called, still closed once |
| 超限输入被拒绝 (lower, empty) | 6 | Negative: 0-byte file → `/1 byte to 20 MiB/`, no read, closed once |
| 替换被拒绝 (size grows mid-read) | 3 | Negative: append during first read → `/changed while being read/`, reads bounded to pre-growth allocation, closed once |
| 替换被拒绝 (mtime/ctime changes) | 4 | Negative: second `fstatSync` returns changed `mtimeMs` → `/changed while being read/`, closed once |
| 同句柄读取 | 5 | Positive structural: exactly one `openSync`; every `readSync` receives that same fd; the identical fd is closed once |

Each positive/negative pair differs only in the intended condition; unrelated guards stay valid (all use real small valid PNGs except the one dimension being flipped), so a different guard can't mask the rejection. Case 3 additionally asserts bounded reads and single close; all rejection cases assert single close (resources closed on error paths too).

**Import paths** verified against the deliverable location: `../src/lib/image-input.js`, `../src/lib/image-file-boundary.js`, `./helpers/image-file-fixtures.js`. No existing suite is imported; only fixture data (`PNG_BYTES`) and the public API are used; no assertion on source text.

**Implementation defects:** none found — the frozen `readBoundedImage` behaves exactly as these tests assert (pins one fd via `openSync`/`finally closeSync`, bounds by `fstatSync` size before read, detects size/mtime/ctime changes, caps reads). No source modification was needed.

**Limitations:** No shell/execution tools were available, so tests were not actually run; I verified import references and reasoned against the source statically. Independent test execution is deferred to the checker's network-disabled environment.
